axes.notes: Research price is USDT per SOL (close of bar t). For the LONG entry the mapped side is SELL (axis E). With base=USDC(6 dec), quote=WSOL(9 dec), a SELL observation is ExactIn USDC->WSOL: requested_input_atomic is USDC atomic, quoted_output_atomic is WSOL atomic. Per qntyspot/solana.py:1173-1177 the SELL human price is (quoted_output_atomic * 10^input_decimals) / (requested_input_atomic * 10^output_decimals) = WSOL_human / USDC_human = WSOL per USDC (quote-per-base), the exact reciprocal of the familiar USDC-per-SOL research price under the 1:1 wrap. The gate at qntyspot/solana.py:1414-1415 accepts the rung when average >= limit_price (fails when average < limit_price). DIRECTION TEST: the execution acquisition price P_exec = USDC_human / WSOL_human is definitionally monotone with the research price P_sol (higher SOL price => higher USDC paid per WSOL acquired). The internal average A = WSOL/USDC = 1/P_exec is a strictly DECREASING function of P_sol, and the side-dependent comparisons invert with it: the SELL (LONG entry) gate accepts exactly when P_sol <= 1/limit_price (entry at low SOL prices, buy-low semantics), and the BUY (FLAT exit) gate at qntyspot/solana.py:1412-1413 (fail when average > limit_price) accepts exactly when P_sol >= 1/limit_price (exit at high SOL prices, sell-high semantics). For any two market states P1 < P2, whenever the entry gate accepts at P2 it also accepts at P1, and whenever the exit gate accepts at P1 it also accepts at P2: the acceptance sets are the correct low-price entry interval and high-price exit interval. Direction is preserved end-to-end through the (side, gate) pair; the reciprocal nature of the raw average is recorded explicitly so it is never silently read as a USDC-per-SOL price.

axes.notes: This policy declares side=BUY with base=USDC and quote=WSOL, so its side=BUY literally means: spend WSOL (quote) to acquire USDC (base) = Jupiter ExactIn WSOL->USDC = dispose of SOL = SOL-EXIT in research semantics. Its exit ladder (USDC-SOL-1) carries side.opposite = SELL = ExactIn USDC->WSOL = acquire SOL = SOL-ENTRY in research semantics. Therefore the H003 causal target LONG (acquire SOL, per H003_SIGNAL_INTENT_V0 signal.causal_target_t_plus_1=LONG) maps to side=SELL on THIS policy (ExactIn USDC->WSOL), and FLAT maps to side=BUY on THIS policy (ExactIn WSOL->USDC). Mapping table: LONG -> side=SELL, level USDC-SOL-1 mechanics, ExactIn USDC->WSOL. FLAT -> side=BUY, level SOL-USDC-1 mechanics, ExactIn WSOL->USDC. NOTE the level-id roles: on this policy the ENTRY ladder (SOL-USDC-1) mechanically executes side=BUY (WSOL->USDC), which is the SOL-EXIT direction; the EXIT ladder (USDC-SOL-1) mechanically executes side=SELL (USDC->WSOL), which is the SOL-ENTRY direction. The H003 bridge consumes DIRECTION (LONG/FLAT) and must map it onto the side that acquires SOL (SELL on this policy), not onto the ladder named entry.
